3455-3605-4808-5131.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Vizier of Many Faces by paying {2}{U}{U}, causing it to enter as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

4785-5078-6650-8171.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
4785-5078-6650-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4419-4694-5226-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4419-4694-5226-7306.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

728-4871-6291.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token due to Stridehangar Automaton.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2281-3899-6132.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Saffi triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1445-4871-6495-7422.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-6495-7422.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
1445-4871-6495-7422.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

997-1981-2415-5708.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

261-1981-2415-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
261-1981-2415-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2557-3129-4772-4826-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3129-6441-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Primal Vigor and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
3129-6441-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

2557-4365-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Parallel Lives and Mondrak.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
2557-4365-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

2292-4871-5220-7855--180.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, Pitiless Plunderer, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-3699-6968.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a creature token.
3259-3699-6968.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Cadira, triggering Breath of Fury and Cadira.
Resolve the Cadira trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3446-3532-5078-7736.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

4149-4359-4599-4871-6019.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

796-1618-2440-7375.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Poppet Stitcher
796-1618-2440-7375.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Arc Blade.
Arc Blade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Poppet Stitcher triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Arc Blade.
Repeat.
796-1618-2440-7375.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Poppet Stitcher. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

413-891-2730.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Boonweaver Giant trigger, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3277-4050-7364.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Izzet Chronarch and another nontoken creature, adding {1}{W}.
Cast Continue? by paying {1}{W}, returning Izzet Chronarch and at least one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Continue? from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
3277-4050-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to two additional creatures each loop to net mana.

4907-5147-6556-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
4907-5147-6556-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

539-1912-4657.notablePrerequisites: You control two creatures excluding Magus of the Candelabra that do not have summoning sickness.
539-1912-4657.description:
Activate two creatures other than Magus of the Candelabra by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {1} due to Biomancer's Familiar and tapping it, untapping it and the two other creatures.
Repeat.

791-3231-3693-7186.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-3231-3693-7186.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

141-780-6798.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 5.

2438-3234-3293-5226.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2438-3234-3293-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat
2438-3234-3293-5226.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2034-2198-4679-6023.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Deceiver Exarch.
When the Deceiver Exarch token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Deceiver Exarch token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2921-4681-4730-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sparring Mummy, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sparring Mummy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

1449-4499-4893.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Plundering Barbarian.
When Plundering Barbarian enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

5473-5657-5664.description:
Cast Writhing Chrysalis by paying {2}{R}{G}.
Ulalek triggers twice, and Writhing Chrysalis' first ability triggers once.
Resolve one of Ulalek's triggers, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Ulalek's trigger and Writhing Chrysalis' trigger.
Resolve the copy of Writhing Chrysalis' trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate both Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens by sacrificing it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger from step 3, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Ulalek's trigger and Writhing Chrysalis' trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
5473-5657-5664.notes: This combo will result in infinite copies of the Writhing Chrysalis spell, resulting in infinite creature tokens. You may also forego the resolution of Writhing Chrysalis' trigger on the first iteration, requiring an additional {C}{C}, but giving you additional triggers to then get infinite Eldrazi Spawns.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of River Kelpie

3388-3607-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of River Kelpie with two additional +1/+1 counters on it and a -1/-1 counter on it.
Remove one +1/+1 counter and one -1/-1 counter from Moritte of the Frost as a state-based action.
When Moritte of the Frost enters the battlefield, it and River Kelpie's first ability triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, milling target player a number of cards equal to Moritte of the Frost's power at the time of activation.
Repeat.

181-549-2105-4836.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents cannot block and kill creatures you control.
You have at least two opponents.
181-549-2105-4836.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant's myriad and printed abilities trigger.
Resolve the myriad trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant attacking each other opponent.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, not exiling the Combat Celebrant tokens due to The Master.
Repeat using a Combat Celebrant token that hasn't attacked this turn.

230-719-853-4871.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent has a card in exile.
"Rat" chosen with Xenograft.
230-719-853-4871.description:
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card an opponent owns from exile into their graveyard, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
When the Eldrazi Scion enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Xenograft, Lord Skitter's first ability triggers, exiling a card from an opponent's graveyard.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Scion dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

186-2544-3371.manaNeeded: {3}, plus enough mana to pay for the nonland card's mana cost minus {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
186-2544-3371.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one instant and/or sorcery card in hand.
186-2544-3371.description:
Activate Codie by paying {3} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {1}{U}, untapping Codie.
Repeat as desired, skipping step 2 on the final iteration.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, cast any spell by paying its mana cost, reduced by the {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} added in step 1.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and/or sorcery card in your hand as mana permits, and on subsequent turns.

38-659-3954.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
38-659-3954.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

2034-2983-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sethron, adding {C}{C}.
Sethron dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Sethron from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Sethron enters the battlefield, creating a 2/3 Minotaur creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Minotaur, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2907-3080.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a land to become a creature.
You have a land card in hand.
You control at least five lands.
2907-3080.description:
Cause a land you control to become a creature.
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}, exchanging the text boxes of the land creature and Scute Swarm.
Play a land.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering the land creature's Scute Swarm ability, creating a copy of itself with its original text.
Step 4 repeats in a mandatory loop unless interrupted, drawing the game.

1030-1636-2297-4242.notablePrerequisites: Bjorna and Othelm do not have summoning sickness.
1030-1636-2297-4242.description:
Activate Bjorna by tapping it and sacrificing Su-Chi, targeting any creature.
Su-Chi dies, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Su-Chi enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve all Bjorna abilities, dealing infinite damage to any creature(s).

224-4222-5196.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Murasa Rootgrazer.
Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
You control a basic Island.
224-4222-5196.description:
Activate a basic Island you control by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's second ability by tapping it, returning the Island from your battlefield to your hand.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's first ability by tapping it, putting the Island from your hand onto the battlefield.
The Island enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhem, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Repeat.

224-280-1257.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.
